resources.string: The domain can have letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore
SFTP is for SSH hosts. Open the host for its desktop or console.
Opens in the built-in remote desktop of TermiNow. To go through SSH, pick a jump host below: TermiNow opens the tunnel with its key and closes it with the desktop.
The jump host of an RDP host must be an SSH host
Opens a PowerShell console through WinRM, which runs in the Ubuntu environment. Keep HTTPS and its check on unless the server has neither.
This connection ended. Open the host to connect again.
Pointer mode: drag to move the pointer, tap to click, two fingers to scroll or right click, long press to drag.
Touch mode: tap where you click, long press for a right click, drag to drag, two fingers to scroll.
Clipboard sharing is off for this host. Turn on Share text of the clipboard in the host settings to copy text between the phone and Windows.
The clipboard of the phone has no text
Sent to the clipboard of Windows
Still connected: resume it from Quick Launch
This connection is gone: TermiNow was closed since. Open the host to connect again.
The connection broke, like when the network changes. TermiNow tries again.
A remote desktop of this host is still open. Resume it, or start a new connection?
This host is not in the vault that is shown anymore
This host can not be opened (%1$s). Check its settings.
This build of TermiNow has no remote desktop engine (%1$s).
No network: the desktop connects again when it is back
Windows did not accept the username or password.
The computer could not be reached. Check the address, the port and the network.
The connection was stopped, like when a certificate was refused.
The security of the connection could not be agreed. If the computer has no NLA, turn it off in the host settings.
The SSH tunnel did not open. Its host must log in with a key or the agent, without a password prompt.
The remote desktop engine is not in this build.
The connection ended with an error.
The certificate of %1$s could not be verified. Accept it only if you know these details are those of the computer.
The certificate of %1$s is not the one that was accepted before. This happens after a reinstall or a new certificate, but also when someone is between you and the computer.
Keep in this host, encrypted on the phone
Not kept: the host logs in with an identity, or it is not in this vault
The HTTPS certificate of the server is not trusted. Add its CA to Ubuntu, or turn off Verify the certificate for this host if you trust the network.
WinRM needs pywinrm in the %1$s environment. TermiNow runs this there, as root:\n\n%2$s
Not installed. WinRM can not connect without python3-winrm.
The install ended with exit code %1$d. See the lines above.
WinRM runs in the Ubuntu environment of TermiNow, which is not installed. Install Ubuntu from Quick Launch, then open this host again.
A PowerShell console of this host is still open. Resume it, or start a new connection?
